tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search published World Innovation research abstracts and white papers by topic or keyword. Returns titles, authors, short summaries and links.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Get one World Innovation paper: title, author, abstract, keywords, publish date, SHA-256 fingerprint and blockchain proof.

tools.name: verify_paper
tools.description: Check whether a SHA-256 fingerprint (or a paper slug) matches a World Innovation paper anchored on the Soneium blockchain, and return its on-chain timestamp. The proof shows the exact text existed at that time; it does not show the ideas are correct or peer reviewed.

tools.name: cite_paper
tools.description: Get a ready-to-use citation for a World Innovation paper (APA-style text and BibTeX).
